fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Trim trees and shrubs along both sides of the access drive to maintain clear vehicle clearance for emergency apparatus.
• Cut back vegetation at the driveway entrance to improve sightlines for responders turning onto the property.
• Clear a turnaround area near the residence so fire and emergency vehicles can reverse direction without backing the full length of the drive.
• Keep the access drive free of parked vehicles, equipment, and debris to maintain the full width for emergency apparatus.
• Thin dense vegetation along the sides of the residence to allow responders to move around the building on foot.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree cluster nearest to the structure to create open space between the trees and the building.
• Remove shrubs and low-growing plants growing directly against or within a few feet of the structure.
• Trim branches on large trees near the structure so the lowest branches are well above the ground.
• Clear dead grass, leaves, and other loose plant material from the ground around the structure.
• Thin scattered shrubs between the tree cluster and the structure to reduce the amount of connected plant material leading toward the building.
• Cut back or remove shrubs and low branches along both sides of the driveway to keep it passable for vehicles.
• Trim overhanging tree branches above the driveway that could fall and block access.
• Remove dead or dry plant material along the driveway that could ignite and spread fire toward the structure.
• Thin scattered trees across the property to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Cut back ground vegetation along the base of large trees so fire cannot climb from the ground into the tree canopy.
• Keep the area around any outbuildings or detached structures clear of shrubs and loose plant material.
• Maintain the single access route by keeping vegetation trimmed back and the road surface free of debris and overhanging limbs.
